correctness.rationale: Grounded Laplacian for two-rail ladder is inverted in symmetric/antisymmetric modes; antisymmetric Green function (H+2I)^-1 produces rung row sum R_k=1+2(2Gkk-G1k-Gnk) and rail row sum T_k=2-(G1k-G1,k+1)+(Gnk-Gn,k+1)<2. Hyperbolic Green kernel proves central rung maximization; small cases n<=4 settled exactly. Recurrences follow from cosh recurrence t_{m+2}=4t_{m+1}-t_m and both parity branches increase to 1+2/sqrt3; the first M_n>2 is n=5. Independent exact rational incidence-projection matrices n=2..10 matched all maxima/edge winners and recurrence values, not extrapolated as the proof.
